commitReviewed: 5f6af0888 (cards pass 4 record; cards carried by wip sync 885d5151e)
method: Read every shipped splash and portrait (base and both skins) at full size, at 480 px card size and at 128/64 px chip size, plus the icons; zoomed faces, hands and feet at 2.5-8x; compared every painted card against its cached 3D reference (art/.cache/fighters/paint/<sid>_<kind>_3d.png) and the in-game three_* renders. Eye saturation sampled with PIL. Store gate: node tools/gen_store.ts --check.
storeGate: pass: store.json is current (32 offers, 8 shelves; dE gate 32/32 pass)
scoreNote: Gauge only, against a recent LoL splash. Kemdo: the painted base and skins are on-model and coherent, with painted light, but the figure is small in the splash frame and the face is a wrap with a slit, so the card has no focal read at 480 px. Sukri: three of six cards are still 3D stills, and the face disc carries cracks, grain lines and eye defects on every card.

perCard.issues: On-model with the 3D reference: pose, silhouette, staff and lens, sash and pauldron. No invented props. Feet are seated with a contact shadow, and the verify2 floating boot is fixed. Minor: at 8x the eyes smear into a red-brown slit with pale blobs (x 1160-1220, y 310-345), much less legible than the 3D's lidded eyes, and the carved scallop brow band is repainted as a diamond lattice. Neither reads at native or card size.
Very close to the render (light paint). The eyes are lidded with pupils. The card hand on the haft has separate fingers. The hood is soft and rounded.

On-model, and the verify2 all-round halo is gone. Minor: a thin cream rim still runs along the back edge of both boots (x 1060-1290, y 790-850), and the raised fist sits beside the staff rather than visibly round it, which is the same in the 3D reference. At card size the eyes do not resolve under the white hood.
Verify2's invented blue clasp band is gone, since the 3D card shipped. The eyes are lidded with pupils. It is a 3D still, so it carries less painted form than the base portrait.

On-model, and verify2's sticker outline is gone. The eye is lidded with a dark pupil. Watch: the eye slit is saturated orange under the lantern grade, a warm read at card size, but it does not glow. A faint pale rim remains on the right boot.
On-model with the warm grade, and the eye is clear. Line consistency: Kemdo's base and skins now all carry the painted style except the 3D Highrim portrait, a mild style break.

Glowing or ember-eye class, the same defect that failed sukri_shadeprint_portrait in verify2: the paint turns both irises saturated amber with a bright ring round the pupil, against the render's dark brown eyes. Eye S p95 is 213 and 218 painted against 182 and 187 in the 3D ref, boxes (150,260,200,305) and (235,260,300,300). The prompt itself forbids 'no bright or saturated ring round the iris'. The gate shows v2 had the largest eye shift of the three passing variants (eye_ds 26.8 against v1 9.1 and v3 10.5), yet it was picked. Also, a jaw crack still runs from below the right mouth corner to the chin edge (x ~270-290, y ~360-400), although ac13f7534 says the jaw cracks were wiped. A dark tick drops from the lower lid of the viewer-left eye, a tear-streak watch.

The jaw crack is still there: a vertical line from the mouth corner to the chin edge (x ~1130-1150, y ~315-350). Vertical grain lines on the forehead and nose bridge run between the eyes. The lantern fist is still four stacked sausage rolls (x 1150-1230, y 320-400), so the pass-4 card hands did not fix it on this card. Sensitivity watch, leaning fail: the pale, flat doll face disc with amber whites, cream bandage bands round the torso and wrapped shins together give a mummy or doll read at full size. The root is the GLB (the three_sukri render has the same cream banded torso), and _design/fighters/sukri.md asks for brown-grey wraps (#7E766A, L* ~50), not cream.

Two vertical jaw cracks rise from the chin edge (x ~330 and ~385, y ~250-285 in the 512 card), in both the 3D and the painted card. The paint strengthens the vertical grain lines that run down the cheeks from below both eyes (x ~300-320, y ~200-240), the eye-to-cheek streak class. The face reads as a pale carved mask with a fixed grin inside a dark hood, which leans toward mannequin. It is on-model otherwise, with no invented props.

Tear-streak class: a small dark drip tick hangs under each eye at the lower lid (face crop x 1080-1260, y 240-420; at 3.5x the ticks sit at about x 1115,y 325 and x 1238,y 328). A vertical line runs down beside the nose from the inner eye corner. The jaw crack is at the lower right of the disc. Heavy half-lidded eyes give a sly or glaring read at card size, verify2's watch item still open. Grounding is acceptable. A pale rim runs along the staff and the right boot's heel.

BLOCKER (hollow-eye class): both pupils render pale lavender and read as holes showing the violet plate through the mask (pupil means ~(100,87,144) and (79,66,101), face crop x 1070-1250, y 200-370). paint.json admits this is still open, so the card should not have shipped. The palette is off-model: the wraps sample saturated violet (torso median 115,91,188), while the in-game three_sukri_shadeprint render has slate grey-blue stripes and the design gives ink #2B2A33. The store card and the in-game skin do not read as one skin. No visible contact shadow under the boots (x 1060-1440, y 700-800), so the figure floats on the platform. A stray dark triangular speck sits left of the mask (about x 1074, y 349). The foreground dark tree at the right has a lilac fringe.

Reaper read: cropped at the frame edge, the pale angled staff crook reads as a curved scythe blade across a hooded masked figure in violet (x 0-180, y 260-450). Together with the sly half-lidded grin this leans toward horror at card and chip size. The mask colour is olive-gold here and orange-tan on the splash, so the two cards do not show one mask (ruling 30 asks for one ruling-2 amber mask). Eyes have pupils and do not glow.

problems.what: Pale lavender pupils read as hollow see-through eyes.
problems.fix: Close the pupil read at the model or the card: an opaque dark-umber pupil disc and an upper-lid shadow in the eye inlay, then re-render the splash. Do not ship until the pupils sample darker than the iris.

problems.what: A saturated amber iris ring gives the ember-eye read (S p95 ~215 against ~185 in the render). The picked variant had the largest eye shift.
problems.fix: Accept v1 or v3 (eye_ds ~9-10) after an eye look, or ship the 3D portrait. Add an absolute eye S p95 cap (<= render + 15) to the pre-gate.

problems.what: Jaw cracks and vertical grain lines on the face disc are still visible on every Sukri card despite 'jaw cracks wiped'. Stillwater adds drip ticks under the eyes.
problems.fix: Wipe the cracks and the vertical grain in the eye-to-chin band in the face-disc texture (units or GLB lane), rebuild sukri*.glb, then re-render all six cards.

problems.what: Violet-saturated wraps unlike the in-game slate stripes, a different mask colour between splash and portrait, no contact shadow, and a scythe-like staff crop on the portrait.
problems.fix: Grade the Shadeprint plate light so the wraps keep the model's slate or ink value, grade both cards' mask to #B39272, add the catcher contact shadow, and reframe the portrait so the crook is either whole or out of frame.

problems.what: Sausage lantern fist and a mummy- or doll-leaning read from cream bandage bands plus the flat face disc.
problems.fix: Apply the card-hand pass to the lantern hand. Raise with the units lane that the torso wraps render cream where the sheet specifies brown-grey #7E766A.

problems.what: A thin pale rim remains along the back edges of the boots.
problems.fix: Limit the rim falloff on the lower legs.
